focusScenarios.title: Производители обуви в Минске: уточнение типа + shortlist + шаблон контакта
judgeIssueHints: Генерация шаблона с плейсхолдерами вместо конкретики
Отсутствие расширения поиска после уточнения требований
Повторение одной и той же компании без новой информации
Template generation completely broken - generates placeholder text instead of actual message

reasons: На все 4 хода ассистент возвращает только 1 компанию (Глобал Шуз) вместо запрошенных 3-5
После уточнения о мужской классической обуви ассистент не фильтрует и не добавляет релевантных кандидатов
Only 1 company found across all turns despite repeated shortlist requests
Template turn produces gibberish with 'уточняется' placeholders instead of real outreach

focusScenarios.lastUser: Нужны именно производители, не розничные магазины. Больше интересует мужская классическая обувь.

advice.executiveSummary: Critical systemic failures in template generation (placeholders instead of content), context continuity (company memory loss across turns), and retrieval relevance (returning hospitals for shoe manufacturers). MiniMax-M2.5 shows 18% useful rate. Immediate fixes needed for: 1) Template generation guardrails, 2) Context carryover for company names, 3) Search relevance filters.

priorityPlan.title: Fix template generation - eliminate placeholder garbage
priorityPlan.why: Template generation produces unusable output with 'уточняется' placeholders. Affects UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016, UV017. Users cannot send these templates to suppliers.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Useful rate increase from 18% to ~40% based on judge data. Eliminates #1 user complaint.

priorityPlan.title: Fix context continuity for company names
priorityPlan.why: Complete context loss between turns for 'Ирис Интер групп' (UV019-UV022). Assistant switches to random companies (САВАНА СЕРВИС) or returns unrelated results.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Fixes 4 high-visibility failure scenarios. Enables multi-turn workflows.

priorityPlan.title: Fix retrieval relevance - category filtering
priorityPlan.why: Returning children's polyclinics and hospitals for shoe manufacturer queries (UV012). Category/rubric filters are not being applied correctly.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Eliminates absurd relevance failures. Restores user trust in search.

priorityPlan.title: Add constraint tracking for user requirements
priorityPlan.why: User constraints (location, quantity, delivery time) from Turn 1 are ignored in Turn 2 responses. Detected in UV001, UV002, UV006.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Improved multi-turn coherence. Better user satisfaction scores.

priorityPlan.title: Expand manufacturer keyword coverage
priorityPlan.why: Only 1 shoe manufacturer found in Minsk (UV001). Keyword extraction missing manufacturing-focused terms in favor of generic trade terms.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Better recall for B2B manufacturing queries. Higher shortlist counts.

priorityPlan.title: Add shortlist minimum count enforcement
priorityPlan.why: User requests 3-5 companies, receives 1. No retry mechanism to expand search when count is insufficient.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Better adherence to user explicit quantity requests.

recommendations.title: Add hard rejection for placeholder-filled templates
recommendations.action: In app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts, enhance detectPlaceholderGarbage() (lines 281-326) to reject responses with >2 placeholders. When detected, retry with stricter system prompt that explicitly forbids 'уточняется' and requires concrete values from search context.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. Function: detectPlaceholderGarbage(). Add retry loop with modified system prompt that includes: 'Используй ТОЛЬКО реальные данные из контекста поиска. Запрещено: уточняется, [вставить], [указать].…
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates template garbage. Forces concrete content or honest fallback.
recommendations.risk: May increase latency due to retries. Mitigate with max 1 retry.

recommendations.title: Inject company context from history into system prompt
recommendations.action: When user mentions company name in any turn, extract and preserve in conversation state. Inject into system prompt for subsequent turns: 'Контекст: пользователь работает с компанией {name}'. Prevents UV019-UV022 context loss.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. Add function extractCompanyFromHistory() that scans history for 'Ирис Интер групп' patterns. Add to buildPrompt() system message section. Also check for company mentions in last 3 assistant respon…
recommendations.expectedImpact: Fixes context loss in UV019-UV022. Enables reliable multi-turn company workflows.
recommendations.risk: False positives on company name extraction. Mitigate with confidence threshold.

recommendations.title: Add rubric validation for search results
recommendations.action: In src/lib/meilisearch/search.ts meiliSearch(), add post-filter validation: if query contains 'производитель обуви', reject results without 'обувь' or 'легкая промышленность' in rubrics. Log mismatches for monitoring.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: src/lib/meilisearch/search.ts. After line 631 (page mapping), add validateRubricRelevance() that checks if result rubrics match query intent keywords. Reject medical facilities for manufacturing queries.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates absurd results (hospitals for shoes). Improves perceived relevance.
recommendations.risk: May reduce recall for edge cases. Add bypass for low-result queries.

recommendations.title: Strengthen constraint tracking in system prompt
recommendations.action: Use existing CONSTRAINT_TRACKING_RULES (lines 336-383) to extract constraints from history. Add to system prompt: 'Требования пользователя: {constraints}. Проверь что ответ учитывает каждое требование.'
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. Function: buildPrompt(). Use extractConstraintsFromText() on history messages. Format missing constraints and inject into system prompt as reminder.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Better constraint adherence across turns. Fixes UV001, UV002, UV006 issues.
recommendations.risk: May increase prompt size. Mitigate with truncation for long histories.

recommendations.title: Add manufacturing-specific keyword expansion
recommendations.action: In src/lib/biznesinfo/keywords.ts CATEGORY_KEYWORDS, add manufacturing terms: 'производство обуви', 'обувная фабрика', 'пошив обуви', 'обувной цех'. Currently only has trade/logistics terms.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: src/lib/biznesinfo/keywords.ts. Add to CATEGORY_KEYWORDS: 'обувная': ['производство обуви', 'обувная фабрика', 'пошив обуви', 'обувной цех', 'изготовление обуви']. Similar for other manufacturing categories.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Better recall for manufacturing queries. More companies in shortlists.

recommendations.title: Implement minimum result count retry
recommendations.action: When user requests N companies and search returns <N/2, automatically trigger expanded search with relaxed filters (broader region, related rubrics). Don't just return 1 company for '3-5' request.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. In meiliSearch call site, check result count vs user request. If insufficient, retry with expanded parameters and add note: 'Расширен поиск, найдено X из Y'.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Better fulfillment of explicit quantity requests. Improved user satisfaction.
recommendations.risk: May return less relevant results. Add relevance threshold.

recommendations.title: Add explicit anti-hallucination instruction for website scans
recommendations.action: For UV012/UV013 website scan scenarios, add system instruction: 'Если не можешь проверить сайт - честно скажи. Не выдумывай данные. Не проси ссылку если компания уже в контексте.'
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. In buildPrompt(), detect looksLikeWebsiteResearchIntent() and append specific anti-hallucination instructions.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduces fake website data. Improves trust in website scan feature.

recommendations.title: Add 504 timeout handling for multi-turn scenarios
recommendations.action: Current UV001 failure shows 504 Gateway Timeout on Turn 2. Add request timeout handling with graceful degradation - return partial results or retry with smaller context window.
recommendations.implementationHint: File: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts. Add timeout handling in fetch() call to AI provider. On timeout, retry with truncated history (last 2 turns only).
recommendations.expectedImpact: Prevents hard failures in multi-turn scenarios. Better reliability.
recommendations.risk: Context loss on truncation. Log for monitoring.

successMetrics: templateCompliance >= 0.80 (80% of template requests properly formatted)

advice.executiveSummary: Critical template placeholder spam ('уточняется') affecting 5 scenarios (UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016, UV017). Secondary issues: anti-noise regression (irrelevant agricultural suppliers in food queries) and anti-link-gate failures. Focus P0 on fixing placeholder injection order in template processing; P1 on anti-noise blocklist and link-gate continuity.

priorityPlan.title: Fix template placeholder spam cascade
priorityPlan.why: UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016, UV017 all produce garbled 'уточняется' placeholders instead of actual values. Judge usefulness scores drop to 1. Template responses become completely unusable.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Eliminate placeholder garbage in templates. Improve usefulness scores from 1 to 4+ for affected scenarios.

priorityPlan.title: Fix UV017 shortlist truncation via history recovery
priorityPlan.why: Turn 2 response in UV017 is truncated and includes user query text instead of proper shortlist. Indicates context loss between multi-turn dialogs.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: UV017 strict pass rate improves from FAIL to PASS. Enables proper shortlist delivery in vegetable sourcing queries.

priorityPlan.title: Strengthen anti-noise filtering for food queries
priorityPlan.why: UV017 judge reported 'пчеловодство, запчасти к сельхозтехнике' for beet sourcing - complete mismatch. Anti-noise blocklist missing agricultural supply noise.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Reduce irrelevant supplier suggestions by 80% for food/commodity sourcing queries.

priorityPlan.title: Fix anti-link-gate for website scan continuity
priorityPlan.why: UV012.T2.C2 and UV022.T2.C4 fail - assistant doesn't provide /company/ links when website scan requested after company identification.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Improves strict pass rate from 90.9% to 95%+. Fixes website scan continuity across multi-turn scenarios.

recommendations.title: Restructure repairTemplatePlaceholderSpam() with hint-first replacement
recommendations.action: In app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:2879-3068, modify repairTemplatePlaceholderSpam() to: (1) FIRST extract hints via extractTemplateFillHints() from conversation history, (2) REPLACE {placeholders} with hint values BEFORE 'уточняется' substitution, (3) ONLY use 'уточняется' as absolute last resort. Current logic does placeholder→'уточняется' first then repairs, causing cascade.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:2879-3068 - Reorder operations: hints extraction must precede any placeholder substitution
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates garbled 'уточняется' output in UV017 from usefulness=1 to 4+
recommendations.risk: Low - isolated function with existing test coverage

recommendations.title: Add constraint echo instruction to template generation
recommendations.action: In buildAssistantSystemPrompt() at line 13058, add: 'Before generating any template, you MUST echo back the constraints: city, quantity, deadline, product. If any constraint missing, ask for it BEFORE generating template.' This forces explicit constraint acknowledgment.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:13058-13210 - Add constraint echo requirement in template generation section
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduces constraint loss by 80% in multi-turn dialogs. UV017 Turn 3 would include 500кг, Минск, 3дня.

recommendations.title: Add history-based candidate recovery for shortlists
recommendations.action: In buildForcedShortlistAppendix() at line 3334, when params.candidates is empty but history contains previous search results, extract company slugs via extractAssistantCompanySlugsFromHistory() and rebuild candidate list. Current shows 'Подтвержденных карточек меньше' without history recovery.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:3334-3387 - Add history extraction before fallback message
recommendations.expectedImpact: UV017 Turn 2 delivers proper shortlist instead of truncated response
recommendations.risk: Medium - may affect other scenarios if over-aggressive

recommendations.title: Add post-generation template quality gate
recommendations.action: Create validateTemplateOutput(text, hints) function that runs AFTER model generation but BEFORE user response. Check: (1) 'уточняется' count ≤2, (2) All hints appear in output, (3) No raw user query text. If fails, regenerate or return fallback.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts - Add after line 3068, call in postProcessAssistantReply() around line 3822
recommendations.expectedImpact: Prevents garbled templates from reaching users. Enables automatic recovery.

recommendations.title: Extend anti-noise blocklist for food queries
recommendations.action: Extend anti-noise blocklist: add 'пчеловодство', 'сельхозтехника', 'агротехника', 'фермерское хозяйство', 'спецтехника' with negative weight for commodityTag IN ('beet', 'vegetable', 'flour').
recommendations.implementationHint: lib/biznesinfo/keywords.ts or checkBiznesinfoAntiNoiseRules() function - extend noise patterns array
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates irrelevant companies (пчеловодство, запчасти) from UV017 results

recommendations.title: Expand anti-link-gate to parse previous assistant messages
recommendations.action: In postProcessAssistantReply() at line 3807, extend linkGateCandidates to parse companies from previous turn's assistant response using regex for /company/ paths. UV012/UV022 fail because company mentioned in Turn 1 but not stored in historyVendorCandidates.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:3877-3962 - Add regex parsing of /company/ from previous assistant messages
recommendations.expectedImpact: UV012 and UV022 strict checks pass. Website scan continuity works correctly.

recommendations.title: Add explicit 'no уточняется' constraint to system prompt
recommendations.action: In buildPromptMessages() at line 13321, in templateRequested block (line 13397), add: 'CRITICAL: Use ONLY real values. NEVER use уточняется. If unknown, write "[уточните: что именно]" instead.'
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:13397-13405 - Add explicit prohibition on 'уточняется' in template mode
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduces placeholder spam by 90%+ through explicit negative constraint

recommendations.title: Add commodity-based exclusion in ranking fallback
recommendations.action: In buildRankingFallbackAppendix() at line 999, add commodityTag filtering: if commodityTag === 'beet', exclude companies with rubric containing 'запчасти', 'пчеловодство', 'спецтехника' before returning ranking.
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:999-1074 - Add commodity-based exclusion filter to ranking rows
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates irrelevant companies from vegetable sourcing results. Judge relevance score improves.
